    ∀ (l : List α) (s : ωSequence α), map f (l ++ω s) = List.map f l ++ω map f s
proof_text:

theorem cumLen_segment_zero {ls : ωSequence (List α)} (h_ls : ∀ k, (ls k).length > 0)
    (n : ℕ) (h_n : n < (ls 0).length) : segment ls.cumLen n = 0 :=
proof_text:
by
  have h0 : ls.cumLen 0 ≤ n := by simp [cumLen_zero]
  have h1 : n < ls.cumLen 1 := by simpa [cumLen_succ, cumLen_zero]
  exact segment_range_val (cumLen_strictMono h_ls) h0 h1
gold_proof:
by
  have h0 : ls.cumLen 0 ≤ n := by simp [cumLen_zero]
  have h1 : n < ls.cumLen 1 := by simpa [cumLen_succ, cumLen_zero]
  exact segment_range_val (cumLen_strictMono h_ls) h0 h1

statement: theorem getElem?_take {s : ωSequence α} : ∀ {k n}, k < n → (s.take n)[k]? = s k
proof_text:
| 0, _+1, _ => by simp only [length_take, zero_lt_succ, List.getElem?_eq_getElem]; rfl
  | k+1, n+1, h => by
    rw [take_succ, List.getElem?_cons_succ, getElem?_take (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ h), get_succ k s]
gold_proof:
| 0, _+1, _ => by simp only [length_take, zero_lt_succ, List.getElem?_eq_getElem]; rfl
  | k+1, n+1, h => by
    rw [take_succ, List.getElem?_cons_succ, getElem?_take (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ h), get_succ k s]

statement: theorem progress {t : Term Var} {τ : Ty Base} (ht : [] ⊢ t ∶ τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᶠ t' :=
proof_text:
by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at ht
  induction ht
  case var => simp_all
  case abs xs mem ih =>
    left
    constructor
    apply Term.LC.abs xs
    intros _ mem'
    exact (mem _ mem').lc
  case app Γ M σ τ N der_l der_r ih_l ih_r =>
    simp only [eq, forall_const] at *
    right
    cases ih_l with
    | inl val => cases val with | abs M _ => use M ^ N, by grind
    | inr step =>
      obtain ⟨M', _⟩ := step
      use M'.app N
      grind
gold_proof:
by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at ht
  induction ht
  case var => simp_all
  case abs xs mem ih =>
    left
    constructor
    apply Term.LC.abs xs
    intros _ mem'
    exact (mem _ mem').lc
  case app Γ M σ τ N der_l der_r ih_l ih_r =>
    simp only [eq, forall_const] at *
    right
    cases ih_l with
    | inl val => cases val with | abs M _ => use M ^ N, by grind
    | inr step =>

      use M'.app N

theorem isChurchList_trans {ns : List ℕ} {cns cns' : SKI} (h : cns ↠ cns')
    (hcns' : IsChurchList ns cns') : IsChurchList ns cns :=
proof_text:
by
  match ns with
  | [] =>
    intro c n
    exact Trans.trans (parallel_mRed (MRed.head c h) .refl) (hcns' c n)
  | x :: xs =>
    intro c n
    obtain ⟨cx, cxs, hcx, hcxs, hred⟩ := hcns' c n
    exact ⟨cx, cxs, hcx, hcxs, Trans.trans (parallel_mRed (MRed.head c h) .refl) hred⟩
gold_proof:
by
  match ns with
  | [] =>
    intro c n
    exact Trans.trans (parallel_mRed (MRed.head c h) .refl) (hcns' c n)
  | x :: xs =>
    intro c n
    obtain ⟨cx, cxs, hcx, hcxs, hred⟩ := hcns' c n
    exact ⟨cx, cxs, hcx, hcxs, Trans.trans (parallel_mRed (MRed.head c h) .refl) hred⟩

statement: theorem take_theorem (s₁ s₂ : ωSequence α) (h : ∀ n : ℕ, take n s₁ = take n s₂) : s₁ = s₂ :=
proof_text:
by
  ext n
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa [take] using h 1
  | succ n =>
    have h₁ : some (s₁ (succ n)) = some (s₂ (succ n)) := by
      rw [← getElem?_take_succ, ← getElem?_take_succ, h (succ (succ n))]
    injection h₁
gold_proof:
by
  ext n
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa [take] using h 1
  | succ n =>
    have h₁ : some (s₁ (succ n)) = some (s₂ (succ n)) := by
      rw [← getElem?_take_succ, ← getElem?_take_succ, h (succ (succ n))]
    injection h₁
